reason: The date range preset combobox (value Custom) has an empty accessible name (probe-3044f97a3a67): its label element is empty and it has no aria-label, aria-labelledby, title or placeholder, so 4.1.2 fails. It is the first control focused when the menu opens, but the labelled From and To fields and the month grid also set the range and the combobox still announces its value and options, so the task is possible and the finding stays medium.

The popup is role=menu (probe-6c9da6e8285e) but holds a form with a combobox, labelled date inputs, a listbox and a month grid, none of them menu items, so 1.3.1 still fails. Enter on the trigger puts focus on the first control and Tab reaches the From and To fields and the month grid in order, each with its own role, so the range can be set and only the wrapper's role is wrong.

The input is the date range preset selector (value Custom, options such as This month and Last 30 days), and its autocomplete value garbage is a deliberate opt-out, set beside data-1p-ignore, data-lpignore and data-bwignore. It collects nothing about the user, so 1.3.5 does not apply.
criterionAnalysis: 1.3.5 Identify Input Purpose covers inputs that collect information about the user and match a purpose in the WCAG list (name, email, address, card number and so on). This field picks a date range preset, so it matches no listed purpose and 1.3.5 does not apply to it. The autocomplete token garbage is an intentional way to stop browsers and password managers from filling the field (the same input carries data-1p-ignore, data-lpignore and data-bwignore). The field's missing name is a 4.1.2 matter covered by name:label:b565c281853a. No other A or AA criterion covers an unrecognised autocomplete token on a non-personal field.
